title: Whizi | GPT, Claude, Gemini, and more in one AI workspace
excerpt: Access GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and top image generation models in one workspace for less than a single major AI subscription.
content_html:
Whizi · The multi-model AI workspace

Stop paying twice. Get every major AI model in one workspace.

GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and top image-generation models in one plan, starting with 7 days for $1.

What you get

  • GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Kimi, DeepSeek, Grok, and more in one chat.
  • Side-by-side model comparison on the same prompt.
  • Chat with PDFs, generate images, reuse prompt templates.
  • One invoice instead of three or four.

Popular comparisons

  • Whizi vs ChatGPT Plus
  • Whizi vs Claude Pro

What customers say

Common questions

Which AI models are included?

Is there a trial?
